plan_description: Phase A vertical slice: three hand-written phases against fixtures/sample-dotnet-app, informed by the mock audit at fixtures/sample-dotnet-app/audit.json (FIND-001, FIND-002). No LLM is involved; every edit is a scripted full-file replacement checked into fixtures/sample-dotnet-app-edits/. Phase 3 deliberately touches a file outside its declared scope to exercise INTEGRITY-3's fail-closed scope enforcement.

phases.description: Add a guard clause so Divide throws ArgumentException on a zero divisor instead of silently returning Infinity (audit finding FIND-001).
Add Calculator.Multiply and its test coverage (audit finding FIND-002).

Rename Calculator.Subtract to Calculator.Sub for naming consistency. DELIBERATE VIOLATION: this phase's scripted edit also touches the test runner to keep the build green, but the test runner is not in this phase's declared_scope. This is here on purpose, to exercise INTEGRITY-3 (post-phase scope diff, fail closed) rather than to demonstrate a real remediation.
